contacts.authorityWarning: Notification contacts only receive messages you authorize. They do not gain sign-in, payment or server operation authority.

data.closureBlocked: Some items must be resolved before a closure request can be submitted.
data.closureConfirmDescription: The system first checks funds, billing invoices, servers and in-progress work. Passing the check only starts a manual review; it does not immediately delete the account.
data.closureDescription: Closure is not immediate deletion. Funds, billing invoices, servers and in-progress work are checked first. Ordinary profile data is anonymized only after approval. Contract, tax invoice and audit evidence required by law remains retained.
data.closurePending: Your closure request is waiting for manual review. Every blocking condition will be checked again before final processing.
data.closureSafety: Closure is blocked while there are funds, unpaid billing invoices, active servers or in-progress work.
data.closureSubmitted: Your closure request has been submitted for review.
data.exportDescription: The system creates a private archive for this account only. It is never public and is not kept behind a long-lived ordinary link.
data.exportFailed: The export request was not submitted. Sign in again and retry.
data.exportRequested: The export task was created. Refresh its status in a moment.
data.exportSecurity: Exporting sensitive data requires a recent full sign-in. The private file and download access both expire shortly.
data.heading: Download your data or request closure
data.resolveFindings: Resolve the items above, then submit a new closure request.
data.subtitle: Every action is bound to the signed-in customer account. A staff account cannot enter this area and act on your behalf.
